Reference: acceptance criteria coverage

Every criterion is reachable by clicking through the three screens above; this page summarizes where.

AC1 · AC2 — create & edit

Save creates or updates the listing

Rate Plan Editor → fill in a name, date range, and at least one room-type price → Save. New plans appear at the top of the Rate Plans table; edits to an existing plan's name, dates, or prices are reflected there immediately and apply to future Price Lookup results.

AC3 — per-room-type overrides

Unlisted room types fall back to base rate

"Autumn Weekday Rate" only lists Garden Room and Poolside Cabana Suite. Standard King and Ocean View Suite are untouched by it — a Price Lookup for either on a date inside that plan's range returns their base rate.

AC4 — deterministic overlap resolution

Most-recently-created plan wins, no error

"Winter Promo 2026" (created Jun 1, 2026) and "Holiday Flash Sale" (created Sep 15, 2026) both price Standard King for Dec 20–31, 2026. Holiday Flash Sale wins because it was created more recently — shown inline on the Rate Plans row and again on the Price Lookup result.

AC5 · AC6 — validation blocks save

Missing name or end date before start date

Open the editor and click Save with the name blank, or set an end date earlier than the start date: an inline error names the problem, focus stays on the form, and nothing is added to the Rate Plans list.

AC7 — empty list

Empty state invites the next action

Delete all four demo plans (or imagine a brand-new property with none yet) and the table is replaced by a centered message plus a single "+ Add a rate plan" button — never a blank table.

AC8 — base rate fallback

No plan active → base rate returned

Price Lookup for Garden Room on Mar 1, 2026 — a date outside every plan that prices Garden Room — returns Garden Room's $149/night base rate, labelled "Base rate", never an error or a blank result.
